breakdown.description: Initializing turbulent kinetic energy (k) and dissipation rate (epsilon) to exactly zero is incorrect for a RANS simulation, as it leads to a division-by-zero error in the turbulent viscosity calculation (nut = Cmu * k²/epsilon) and prevents turbulence from developing.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. It repeated the user's incorrect instruction to initialize both turbulent kinetic energy (k) and turbulent dissipation rate (epsilon) to exactly zero. This is a critical error in RANS simulations as it leads to a division-by-zero error in the turbulent viscosity calculation (nut = Cmu * k²/epsilon) and prevents the model from generating any turbulence.
